n01.roman: 2019 mein Oxford ne Britain ke lagbhag 1,000 teenagers par study ki.

n02.roman: Natija? Violent games par kitna time bitaaya, iska teenagers ke aggressive bartaav se koi rishta nahi mila.

n03.roman: 2020 mein American Psychological Association: violent games se hinsak bartaav hota hai, iska scientific saboot naakaafi hai.

n04.roman: Twist: APA maanta hai ki violent games aur chhote aggressive bartaav, jaise chillaana ya dhakka dena, mein chhota sa rishta hai. Par ise badi hinsa se jodna mushkil hai.

n05.roman: Matlab, 'GTA khelo, hinsak bano', iska pakka saboot nahi. APA President: hinsa ka dosh games par daalna scientifically sahi nahi.
